text_markup: The {term:text box} is the central area on a card containing any abilities the card has. Abilities usually only apply when the card they appear on is active. {ref:Rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card} details exceptions.
text_plain: The text box is the central area on a card containing any abilities the card has. Abilities usually only apply when the card they appear on is active. Section 9.1.8 details exceptions.
